response.subject: chopper-gunner-cockpit-1080

rows.finding: Capture adds tall converging side-frame beams forming a full trapezoid in r1c0/r1c2/r2c2 that are absent in the reference where the cockpit stops as a low bottom rail, consistent with edgeIoU 0.30-0.64 there.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference lower half r1c0 through r2c2 shows open trees above a low dark horizontal rail with no diagonal side pillars
rows.captureEvidence: capture r1c0 through r2c2 shows bright diagonal beams from bottom corners converging to upper-middle framing the whole view
rows.boundedCorrection: Remove the diagonal side-frame beams and retain only the bottom dashboard rail assembly, changing nothing else.

rows.finding: Cockpit height occupies roughly double the frame fraction in capture versus a thin bottom band in reference, consistent with measured edgeIoU 0.4034, 0.4474, 0.3031 in r2c0/r2c1/r2c2.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference r2c0-r2c2 dashboard band occupies bottom ~25% with rail near bottom third line
rows.captureEvidence: capture r2c0-r2c2 dashboard plus converging sides occupy bottom ~45% with top edge near mid-frame
rows.boundedCorrection: Lower the dashboard top edge to the reference bottom-band height with a horizontal rail, changing nothing else.

rows.finding: Dashboard in r2c0-r2c2 reads as bright emissive translucent mint in capture versus dark opaque matte olive in reference at this gameplay distance.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference r2c1 dashboard panel and tabs read as dark matte opaque olive with small flat color tabs
rows.captureEvidence: capture r2c1 dashboard panel and tabs read as light glossy emissive white-mint with glowing tabs
rows.boundedCorrection: Replace cockpit dashboard and tab materials with opaque non-emissive dark matte material, changing nothing else.

rows.finding: Value hierarchy inverts in r2c1/r2c2 where the cockpit interior is brightest with bloom in capture while the reference cockpit is darkest with sky brightest, consistent with valueEMD 0.19-0.36 in r2.
rows.referenceEvidence: reference r2 sky brightest, cockpit interior in shadow with deep contact shadow under rail
rows.captureEvidence: capture r2 cockpit frame and dashboard bloom as brightest plane, washing trees behind rail
rows.boundedCorrection: Disable emissive intensity and bloom contribution on cockpit frame and dashboard to restore sky-brightest hierarchy, changing nothing else.

notMatchable: Absolute sRGB values of sunset sky and HUD text, S1 is not usable for absolute colour calibration
Print-distance material micro-detail and foliage shape, gameplay-distance frame is not usable for material-class judgement at print distance
Colour-temperature agreement between images, both come from the same renderer so it is not evidence art direction is right
